name: Folding drying rack
notes: Static open pose: A-frame body with two wings folded up at 55 degrees; width 0.7 m along the rails, depth 0.55 m including feet and wing tips.
parts: two tubular A-frame end frames with floor bars
eight fixed rails across the body
front and back wings folded up on hinge clips
plastic hinge clips and end caps
a few clothespins on the lower rail
style: White powder-coated steel tube, scuffed at the feet and clip joints.
summary: Folding wing drying rack: white tubular A-frame with eight rails, two wings folded up on clips, rubber feet and clothespins.
